slots.name: age at death
slots.sentence: Hiroshi Okuda, a hard-charging Toyota executive who revived the floundering automobile maker in the 1990s by expanding production overseas, tightening decision-making at home and pushing through the introduction of the Prius, the world’s first hybrid car in regular production, died on Aug. 8. He was 93.

slots.name: Japan market share
slots.sentence: In 1995, for the first time in many years, it fell below 40 percent of car sales in Japan.

slots.name: accounting tenure
slots.sentence: After spending 17 years as an accountant, he moved into the company’s overseas operations, working in the Philippines and Australia for several years before returning to Japan to join the executive leadership team.
